description: This file defines an interface for database operations related to 'Observations' (Obs) within the OpenMRS medical record system. It declares methods for saving, retrieving, deleting, and counting observation records, as well as fetching observations by various filters like person, encounter, concept, location, and date range.

classes.name: ObsDAO
classes.description: An interface that declares database operations related to Observation entities in OpenMRS, including CRUD operations and various query methods.

methods.name: saveObs
methods.description: Saves an observation record to the database.

methods.name: getObs
methods.description: Retrieves an observation by its unique identifier.

methods.name: deleteObs
methods.description: Deletes an observation from the database.

methods.name: getObservations
methods.description: Fetches a list of observations matching specified filters such as person, encounter, concept, location, date range, and other criteria.

methods.name: getObservationCount
methods.description: Counts observations matching specific filters, optionally including various parameters like person, encounter, concept, date range, and more.

methods.name: getObsByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves an observation by its UUID.

methods.name: getRevisionObs
methods.description: Fetches the previous version of an observation.

methods.name: getSavedStatus
methods.description: Gets the current saved status of an observation, bypassing caches.
